turns.q: Do you ship internationally, and who covers customs or duties?
turns.replyTail:
who covers customs or duties?

Got it, great question! Yes, we ship to many countries worldwide across Europe, Asia, Latin America, the Middle East, Africa, and more. Customs and duties depend on location: in most countries, duties and taxes are included in your product cost, and shipping is calculated at checkout. In the Philippines, duties, taxes, and shipping are all calculated separately at checkout. If you tell me what country you are in, I can share what to expect there.
